development_plan.guard_rule: Before optimization, reserve this fixed guard on both constraints for numerical solver error and policy rounding: solver null<=.0099899 and each power>=.9500101. Exact final acceptance uses the scientific .00999/.95001 constraints; no result-dependent guard changes.
development_plan.classical_controls: Frozen H8192 beta_exact and all11 LR-mixture registry artifacts; no recalibration or removal based on candidate results.
development_plan.pool_qualification: A fixed control must reach .95 correct-report probability at ALL9 design points. Initial pool membership is a float analytic design calculation; margins are reported and it is not called an interval certificate.
development_plan.offline_objective: Minimize t such that candidate all-path expected physical cost at each of9 points is <= t times the minimum cost among the globally qualified fixed-control pool at that point.
development_plan.oracle_boundary: This hindsight envelope defines an offline optimization target only; online policy does not know q,r,case ID or which control is best.
development_plan.abstention_accounting: All paths without a report through H128 pay the full8192 physical pairs; subsequent reports are forbidden. Earlier physical-cap expiry also abstains and pays the full cap.
development_plan.allowed_policy: Symmetric randomized majority report after each discordance, depending only on d and minority-count j; at ties no report. A fresh independent integer coin is consumed only on discordant pairs.

rounding.rule: Snap only within the predeclared tolerance of0 or1, otherwise round to nearest integer numerator.

development_plan.failure_rule: Save numerical solver failure or exact-audit failure without changing q,r,H,cap,targets or objective. Do not claim an infeasibility certificate unless the solver supplied one.
development_plan.reporting: Keep t>=1 outcomes and regressions; report arithmetic and equal-point geometric costs on all9 grid points and all fixed controls. Development only, no SOTA, novelty or threefold claim.
development_plan.prior_art: Classical constrained optimal stopping/alpha spending; Silva, Kulldorff and Yih (2020), doi:10.1111/rssb.12379, is prior art rather than an equivalence claim for this implementation.

protocol.action: After a discordant pair draw a fresh uniform integer in[0,10^12). Report the current majority iff it is below policy_numerators[d][min(k,d-k)]. AtH128 forbid all later reports; unrejected paths still pay to the physical cap.

exact_grid_audit.numerical_method: Exact rational sign first passage, integer binomial low-tail sums, exact truncated negative-binomial expectations. Displayed endpoints are exact rational floor/ceil on a10^-12 decimal grid.

claim_boundary: Classical minimax constrained stopping development on the predefined9-point grid. Policy error/power/cost are rationally audited; fixed-control costs and pool qualification used float analytic design values. No independent benchmark, SOTA, novelty, universal optimality or3x claim. Numerical LP t is not an exact optimality certificate.
